title: Facilities Technician Intern
description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
Join Intel as a Facilities Technician Intern and play a key role in maintaining and improving our building systems and equipment. In this hands-on role, you'll assist with inspections, troubleshoot system failures, and support preventative maintenance tasks to ensure operational efficiency and reliability. Your contributions will help create a safe, sustainable, and effective environment for Intel's teams to thrive.
Facilities management is a critical component of Intel's operations, responsible for ensuring that our campuses function seamlessly to support world-class innovation. This team oversees building systems and infrastructure, focusing on safety, sustainability, and efficiency to align with Intel's broader goals of delivering cutting-edge technology solutions globally.
Key Responsibilities
Assist in the maintenance and repair of building systems and equipment across various facilities domains, including mechanical, electrical, chemical, and water treatment systems.
Conduct inspections and troubleshoot system failures to identify and address operational issues.
Collaborate with the facilities team to execute preventative maintenance tasks and suggest improvements for system reliability and efficiency.
Support compliance efforts by ensuring facility systems align with established safety and energy standards.
Participate in projects and hands-on activities to build technical skills and gain practical experience in facilities engineering and maintenance.
Qualifications:
You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum qualifications and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Experience listed below would be obtained through a combination of your schoolwork, classes, research, relevant previous job, and/or internship experiences.
Minimum Qualifications
Must be pursuing an associate degree (preferred) or a certification in a facilities related field such as HVAC, Electrical, Mechanical, PLC, or a related field of study and be able to work onsite and year round at Intel Rio Rancho while attending school full time.
Must be a full time student and graduating within 3 semesters
Preferred Qualifications
License Journeyman Electrician
Knowledge of life safety systems management and mechanical systems.
Familiarity with water treatment equipment management and related systems.
Discover the opportunity to explore your potential, gain valuable hands-on experience, and contribute to Intel's success in creating exceptional facilities that power our innovation.
